figure3.interpretation: One EMC participant in a 60-patient mixed-tumor trastuzumab deruxtecan trial. Figure 3C identifies the EMC tumor as HER2 IHC 1+ and ISH-negative; its best plotted size change is an increase, with further growth over follow-up. This is not an EMC objective response. The pooled response rate must not be attributed to EMC. NR4A3 confirmation and a patient-specific response table remain unresolved.
